sentences.text: Shri Pramod Kumar Sahu - Advocate for the applicant.

Shri Santosh Yadav - Govt. Advocate for respondent/State.
 Order

This is first application under Section 483 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 has been filed on behalf of the applicant for grant of bail in connection with FIR/Crime No.387/2025 dated 14.06.2024 registered at Police Station Amarwara, District Chhindwara, for the offence punishable under Sections 363, 366(ka), 376(2)(n), 506 of I.P.C and Under Section 5 & 6 of POSCO Act.
2. Learned counsel for the applicant contends that the prosecutrix and the applicant have already entered into wedlock, which is evident from the certificate contained in Annexure A/2.

It is contended by the counsel that the prosecutrix and the applicant herein a consensual relationship and the prosecutrix eventually got pregnant as well and considering the fact that the prosecutrix and the applicant are now husband and wife, the applicant, who is in custody since 10.04.2025, deserves to be enlarged on bail.
3.

Learned counsel appearing for State opposed the prayer and NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-JBP:25339 2 MCRC-20519-2025 submitted that the offence in question was committed against the minor and therefore the applicant is not entitled for bail.
However, learned counsel for the State has not disputed that the prosecutrix and the applicant have already entered into wedlock and the prosecutrix eventually got pregnant as well.

sentences.text: 4. Heard the submissions and perused the case diary.
5. Considering the overall facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any view on the merits of the case, the application is allowed.

6. It is directed that the applicant-Devendra Verma shall be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned for his appearance before the said Court on all such dates as may be fixed in this regard during the pendency of trial.

7. It is further directed that the applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 480(3) of the BNSS.
8.
Accordingly, this M.Cr.C. stands disposed of.
